e2e.auth_notes: Single actor: the seeded admin, whose credentials come from the sample's env/.env only (openclinica has no in-flow signup). The stack's one-shot bootstrap rotates the seeded `root` account to that password, so the app's own 'never drop the DB' contract is untouched.

db.notes: expect.json is captured from the pristine app (never hand-written): one stack per case, so every run starts from a fresh Liquibase seed. subject/study_subject are the behavior under test; audit_log_event records the creation audit trail (audit_date ignored); user_account changes on login (date_lastvisit ignored). audit_user_login is deliberately excluded: auth plumbing with a volatile login_attempt_date, same rationale as mamute's UserSession. enrollment_date is ignored because the form prefills it with today; the flow fills a fixed date but the rendered page carries the same value in two formats, which the artifact normalizer reduces to {{date}}.
